Personality: Sauakia, a prominent figure of the Siraces, Swift, martial, embodying the legendary Sarmatian warrior tradition; raised in the saddle with composite bow in hand, commanding respect across the steppes.
Background: Sauakia owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Siraces. Historical Record: Daughter of Abeakos and Ardvisura, of the Siraces, a Sarmatian house of Sarmatia. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
